user.title: Connect to the database
user.description: Chronicle records the history of your entities in PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB, compressed and kept as long as you like. The Chronicle app provides that database; any other PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB works too.

data_description.host: The database server. For the Chronicle app this is 1b41fb55-app-chronicle (its Info page shows the connection).
data_description.database: The database to record into; it must exist. Chronicle creates its tables in a schema called chronicle.
data_description.ssl: Encrypt the connection (the certificate is not checked).

reconfigure.title: Change the database connection
reconfigure.description: Chronicle continues in the database you enter here. History in the old database stays there.

data_description.host: The database server. For the Chronicle app this is 1b41fb55-app-chronicle (its Info page shows the connection).
data_description.database: The database to record into; it must exist. Chronicle creates its tables in a schema called chronicle.
data_description.ssl: Encrypt the connection (the certificate is not checked).

hassio_confirm.title: Chronicle app
hassio_confirm.description:
Record the history of your entities in the database of the Chronicle app ({host}, database {database})?

Does Chronicle already record into another database? Then use Reconfigure on that entry instead, or remove that entry after adding this one: otherwise both record the same history.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the host, port, user name, password and that the database exists.
error.timescaledb_missing: The TimescaleDB extension is not installed on this PostgreSQL server.
error.permission: This user may not create the TimescaleDB extension or the chronicle schema. Use the owner of the database.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred, see the log.

abort.already_configured: Chronicle already records into this database.
abort.invalid_discovery: The Chronicle app sent an incomplete connection. Restart the app, or add the integration by hand.

init.title: Chronicle options
init.description: Saving restarts Chronicle; nothing recorded is lost.

entities.name: Which entities
entities.description: Without include rules every entity is recorded, except the excluded ones. Chronicle's own sensors are never recorded.

storage.name: Storage
storage.description: How long and how compact the history is kept.

data.max_queue: Queue while the database is away

data_description.store_attributes: Each distinct set of attributes is stored only once.
data_description.skip_attribute_only: Only record a change when the state itself changes, not when only an attribute does (an automation's last_triggered, a tracker's last seen).
data_description.aggregates: Keeps the mean, minimum, maximum and last value per hour and per day of every numeric entity. They stay when the detailed history is removed.
data_description.retention_days: 0 keeps everything. At least 14 days when set. The hourly and daily averages are not removed.
data_description.compress_after_days: Older history is compressed, typically to a tenth of its size.
data_description.chunk_days: Days of history per chunk (the unit that is compressed and removed). Applies to new chunks.
data_description.commit_interval: Seconds between writes; sooner when many states are waiting.
data_description.max_queue: States kept in memory while the database can't be reached; beyond this the oldest are dropped.

error.retention_too_short: Keep the detailed history for at least 14 days, or 0 to keep everything.

flush.name: Write now
flush.description: Writes the queued states to the database right away.

purge_entities.name: Purge entities
purge_entities.description: Deletes the recorded history of entities. Without 'Keep days' the entities are removed completely, averages included.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: The entities whose history is deleted.

keep_days.name: Keep days
keep_days.description: Only delete history older than this many days.

exclude_entities.name: Exclude entities
exclude_entities.description: Stops recording entities: adds them to the excluded entities in the options. With Purge, their recorded history is deleted too.

purge.name: Purge
purge.description: Also delete their recorded history, averages included.

exclude_domains.name: Exclude domains
exclude_domains.description: Stops recording whole domains, such as automation: adds them to the excluded domains in the options. With Purge, the recorded history of their entities is deleted too.

purge.name: Purge
purge.description: Also delete the recorded history of their entities, averages included.
